description: Current US market status (open, closed, pre-market, after-hours), S&P 500 / Nasdaq / Dow ETF prices (SPY, QQQ, DIA) with % change, and top market news. Before the open, an index with change_basis "last_session" shows the last session's close and move, and extended_change_pct a pre-market trade's move since that close. Cached ~60 seconds.
name: get_market_pulse
title: Market pulse
